planted.description: EnforceCodeStyleInBuild turned off. IDE rules from .editorconfig no longer reach the build.
NoWarn hides nullable warnings (CS8602, CS8618) and the log template rule (CA2254) for the whole repo, to make the build pass.
Legacy rule set file. Configure severities in .editorconfig.
One SARIF path for all projects: each project overwrites the same file. Use a per-project path in obj/ (and add version=2.1).
Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers package (old 9.0.0) in a .NET 10 project. The SDK already ships newer analyzers; use AnalysisLevel.
SonarAnalyzer.CSharp: its SSALv1 license forbids AI analysis of its output. New package without approval.
SecurityCodeScan: not maintained since 2022 (LGPL). Use the CA security rules.
Whole Roslynator category raised to warning. It also raises Hidden rules (noise). Raise single rule IDs.
CA2007 (ConfigureAwait) as warning in an ASP.NET Core app, and ConfigureAwait(false) added to app code. Noise; turn CA2007 off for apps.
File-wide '#pragma warning disable' with no restore and no reason. All warnings in the file are hidden.
CI gate uses 'roslynator analyze' (silently skips newer analyzers such as Meziantou) and 'dotnet build' without -warnaserror, with a command-line ErrorLog that every project overwrites.
Since Roslynator 5.0 the VSIX has no analyzers. Use the NuGet package.
